parsed.name: Wasatch 拉曼演示程序
parsed.description: 用于拉曼实验演示的非物理软件组件。它负责解析命令行参数、连接激光驱动板与 IDS 相机，并在运行循环中协调采集光谱或图像、按需触发激光以及保存数据文件与 PNG 结果。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for Raman experiment demonstration. It parses command-line arguments, connects to a laser driver board and an IDS camera, and coordinates spectrum or image acquisition in a run loop, optionally firing the laser and saving data files and PNG outputs.

actions.description: 解析演示程序的运行参数与采集选项。
actions.description_en: Parse the demo application's runtime parameters and acquisition options.

actions.description: 连接激光驱动板与 IDS 相机，并同步激发波长等信息以支持波数计算。
actions.description_en: Connect to the laser driver board and IDS camera, and synchronize excitation wavelength information to support wavenumber calculation.

actions.description: 运行采集循环，读取光谱或图像、按需触发激光，并保存数据与图像结果。
actions.description_en: Run the acquisition loop to read spectra or images, trigger the laser as needed, and save data and image outputs.
